entries.title: 1D Cellular Automata

entries.desc: Exciting court battles in Chip8! Disc 1/3 of an exciting multi-tape game.

entries.title: 8CE Attourny - Disc 2

entries.title: 8CE Attourny - Disc 3
entries.desc: Exciting court battles in Chip8! Disc 3/3 of an exciting multi-tape game.
entries.howto: Any key except 3 clicks on to the next line. Disc three of a courtroom drama.

entries.title: An Evening to Die For
entries.desc: It is a dark and stormy night. A murder has been committed...

entries.title: Applejak
entries.desc: Interpreter for a subset of APL/K.

entries.title: Bad Kaiju Ju
entries.desc: The year is 1977. 90% of the world's landmass is now underwater and the world is at war...
entries.howto: Hold key 5 to raise the creature beside the tower. It only appears while the key is down.

entries.title: Black Rainbow
entries.desc: Plumb the depths of your subconscious and bring back the motherlode...
entries.howto: Key 9 steers you right as you sink. Plumb the depths and bring the motherlode back up.

entries.title: Br8kout
entries.desc: You can't even imagine how amazing this breakout clone is!
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 slide the paddle. Clear the bricks without letting the ball past you.

entries.title: Bulb
entries.desc: Interpreter for a language which resembles toenail clippings.

entries.title: Business Is Contagious
entries.desc: capitalism.txt

entries.title: Carbon8
entries.desc: A period correct movie tie in game for a popular 1980s franchise.

entries.title: Cave Explorer
entries.desc: Do you have what it takes to be a Cave Explorer?

entries.title: Chicken Scratch
entries.desc: What if Pac-Man, but Chicken?
entries.howto: Key 6 starts it. Keys 5 7 8 9 move the chicken around the maze. Pac-Man, but chicken.

entries.title: Chipcross
entries.desc: 16 levels of Picross implemented in CHIP8. 800 bytes of fun.
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move the cursor, key 6 marks the square under it. Sixteen levels of Picross.

entries.title: Chipquarium
entries.desc: A CHIP-8 fish tank simulator.
entries.howto: A fish tank to watch rather than a game to win. Key E brings up how hungry and how happy the fish are.

entries.title: ChipWar
entries.desc: A (loose) adaptation of the classic DiceWars.

entries.title: Civiliz8n
entries.desc: Grow a tiny civilization in 10 turns

entries.title: Danm8ku
entries.desc: Bullet hell for the Chip-8! Survive 8 waves of exciting bullet patterns!

entries.title: Dino Run
entries.desc: An endless runner game for Chip-8.
entries.howto: Key 5 jumps. An endless runner, so the only aim is to keep going.

entries.title: Dodge
entries.desc: Dodging asteroids in 56 bytes.

entries.title: down8
entries.desc: you fall down an endless hole and then you die!
entries.howto: Key 5 to fall. You go down an endless hole and then you die, and there is no avoiding it.

entries.title: DVN8
entries.desc: This is your great-grandma's dungeon crawler. You can see it with the manual at https://systemlogoff.com/share/DVN8/index.html
entries.howto: A first person dungeon crawl. Keys 5 7 8 9 take you through it, redrawing the whole view at each step.

entries.title: Eaty The Alien
entries.desc: An incredible intergalactic adventure.
entries.howto: Key 6 starts it. Keys 5 7 8 9 walk the alien around the screen.

entries.title: Expedition.
entries.desc: A short narrative about going outside.
entries.howto: A short story that reads itself. Hold key 6 to keep the current line up, and let go to move on.

entries.title: Flight Runner
entries.desc: A simple flight runner for the Chip8.
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 steer left and right.

entries.title: Flutter By
entries.desc: A game where you are a butterfly trying to get to flowers.
entries.howto: Key 5 flaps the butterfly upward, key 8 folds its wings. Get to the flowers.

entries.title: Fuse
entries.desc: A minimalist reinterpretation of the classic Pipe Dream.

entries.title: Ghost Escape
entries.desc: Seek revenge on mortal men in this exciting adventure!
entries.howto: Key 0 lifts the ghost upward, and it sinks again when you let go.

entries.title: Glitch Ghost
entries.desc: glitch ghost is all alone in the cemetery, please help them make some friends by turning the trespassing humans into new ghosts!
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move the ghost around the cemetery, and key 6 turns a trespassing human into a new ghost friend.

entries.title: Grad School Simulator 2014
entries.desc: Welcome to the sunless depths of my ennui.

entries.title: Horse World Online
entries.desc: An online horse breeding game.

entries.title: Horsey Jump
entries.desc: Press the X button to make the horse jump over the fence.
entries.howto: Press key 0 to make the horse jump over the fence.

entries.title: Into The GarlicScape
entries.desc: Collect aliums, avoid moths, pet llamas. A template program for Octojam 7.
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move you around. Collect aliums, avoid moths, pet llamas.

entries.desc: Rhythm game. WARNING: Volume

entries.desc: Rhythm game. WARNING: Volume
entries.howto: A rhythm game. Notes fall down four lanes, one for each column of the keypad, and you hit the key as a note lands.

entries.title: jub8 Song 4
entries.desc: Rhythm game. WARNING: Volume
entries.howto: A rhythm game. Keys 1 2 3 C pick your lane before the track starts.

entries.title: jub8 Song 5
entries.desc: Rhythm game. WARNING: Volume

entries.desc: Rhythm game. WARNING: Volume

entries.title: Kesha Was Biird
entries.desc: Second installment in epic saga about Kesha.

entries.title: Kesha Was Bird
entries.desc: A surreal telephone adventure.
entries.howto: A surreal telephone adventure that plays out on its own. Press key 1 to move it on to the next scene.

entries.title: Kesha Was Niiinja
entries.desc: Legendary ninja returns! Who is he? Ruthless killer? Absolute evil? Character with his own purpose? His motives are still unclear, and his story is for you to unfold.
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 walk the ninja left and right, key 5 jumps.

entries.title: Knight
entries.desc: You're Artore the Puny, littlebrother and inferior to your great big brother, King Arthur.
entries.howto: Key D to start. Keys 5 7 8 9 to move, key 4 to dodge, key 6 to attack.

entries.title: Knumber Knower
entries.desc: A game of bad typography.
entries.howto: Key 5 clicks through the title. A game of deliberately bad typography.

entries.title: Masquer8
entries.desc: Cuttlefish pattern matching game for chip8.

entries.title: Mastermind
entries.desc: The classic puzzle game of deduction.

entries.title: Mato8
entries.desc: Snake game (matopeli in Finnish)

entries.title: Mini Lights Out
entries.desc: Turn the lights out
entries.howto: The sixteen keys are the grid, laid out just as they sit on the keypad. Press one to toggle that light, and turn them all out.

entries.title: Mondri8
entries.desc: Draw random compositions in the style of Piet Mondrian.

entries.title: Mr Worm
entries.desc: A snake game with more degrees of freedom, inspired by the TI-89 game.
entries.howto: Any key starts it. Keys 7 and 9 are the only keys it watches. Snake, with more directions than the usual four.

entries.title: Nokia 3310 Template
entries.desc: SCHIP template program for resembling the Nokia 3310

entries.title: Octo paint
entries.desc: Drawing Program
entries.howto: A drawing program. Keys 5 7 8 9 move the cursor, keys 2 and 3 change the brush size, and key F lifts the pen.

entries.title: Octo Party Mix!
entries.desc: It's basically Warioware. But with cute octo buddies!

entries.desc: Train monsters and become a real ranching champion. Read the manual at https://systemlogoff.com/share/Octo-Rancher-Manual.pdf

entries.title: Octo: a Chip 8 Story
entries.desc: A visual novel game for the Chip8.
entries.howto: Press any key to move the story on to its next screen.

entries.title: Octojam 10 Title

entries.desc: Greeting program for the eighth annual 2021 Octojam.

entries.desc: Greetings program for the ninth annual 2022 Octojam.

entries.desc: Peggle clone for Superchip
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 aim the launcher left and right, key 8 drops the ball to bounce down through the pegs.

entries.title: Octovore
entries.desc: a game of hungry hungry octopods
entries.howto: Hold key C to start, because a tap is not enough. A game of hungry hungry octopods.

entries.title: Ordinary Idle Garden

entries.title: Outlaw
entries.desc: An adaptation of the Atari 2600 game "Outlaw" for the Chip8.
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move your gunman, key 6 fires a shot. A duel with the outlaw across the screen.

entries.title: Pet Dog
entries.desc: Undertale fangame made in Chip8.

entries.title: Piper
entries.desc: Play as a small bird to collect goodies and avoid waves.
entries.howto: Any key starts it. Keys 5 7 8 9 move the bird along the beach, and key 6 hides her in the sand when a wave comes.

entries.title: Pumpkin "Dreess" Up
entries.desc: Classic Adobe Flash games, now in Chip8.

entries.title: Red October V
entries.desc: A futuristic RPG.
entries.howto: Press any key to move the opening text on. A futuristic role playing game.

entries.title: Rockto
entries.desc: An adaptation of "Boulder Dash" for the Chip8.

entries.title: RPS
entries.desc: Classic "Rock Paper Scissors" game for the Chip8.

entries.title: Sens8tion
entries.desc: Equilibrium faithfully reproduced in schip.
entries.howto: Keys 1 2 3, 4 5 6 and 7 8 9 make a three by three tilt pad. Lean the needle back to upright.

entries.title: SK8 H8 1988
entries.desc: Don't get trashed out there, GRRL!

entries.title: Skyward
entries.desc: Climb as high as you can!
entries.howto: Key 1 starts it. Keys 5 7 8 9 move the climber. Climb as high as you can.

entries.title: Slippery Slope
entries.desc: The ice we skate is getting pretty thin. The water's getting warm so you might as well swim.
entries.howto: Key 9 skates you on across the thinning ice. The other keys only twitch on the spot.

entries.title: Snake
entries.desc: Classic Snake game without walls.
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 starts it and steers. There are no walls, so you pass through one edge and come back the other side.

entries.title: Snek
entries.desc: Minimalist Snake in 65 bytes.
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 steer the snake up, left, down and right. Minimalist Snake, in sixty five bytes.

entries.title: Space Racer
entries.desc: Based on the classic 2-player 'Space Race' video game.

entries.title: Spacejam!
entries.desc: An extended and enhanced version loosely based on ShipTunnel from the 2014 OctoJam.
entries.howto: Any key starts it. Keys 5 7 8 9 fly the ship up, left, down and right through the tunnel.

entries.title: Spock Paper Scissors
entries.desc: Intergalactic Rock Paper Scissors.

entries.title: Squad
entries.desc: Interpreter for a regular-sized Forth.

entries.title: Sub-Terr8nia
entries.desc: Lander game
entries.howto: A lander game. Keys 5 7 8 9 steer your craft through the cave, and key D starts the run again.

entries.title: Super NeatBoy
entries.desc: Jump, fall, tidy up leaves. A template program for Octojam 7.
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 walk left and right, wrapping round the edge of the screen.

entries.title: Super Octo Track XO
entries.desc: Compose songs with the XO-Chip audio system.

entries.title: Super Octogon
entries.desc: Eight fantastic sides, and eight awesome angles.
entries.howto: Keys 7 and 9 rotate you round the rim, one way and the other. Keep spinning away from the closing walls.

entries.title: Super Pong
entries.desc: A fast pong-like.
entries.howto: Key 6 serves the ball. Keys 7 and 9 slide the paddle, and the ball must not get past you.

entries.title: Super Square
entries.desc: Inspired by Super Hexagon
entries.howto: Key 5 starts it. Keys 7 and 9 are your only controls, steering you around the walls as they close in.

entries.title: Sw8 Copter
entries.desc: An adaptation of "Swing Copters" for the Super Chip8.
entries.howto: Key 6 steers the copter sideways as it falls. An adaptation of Swing Copters.

entries.title: T8NKS
entries.desc: Artillery game

entries.title: Tank!
entries.desc: A two player artillery game.
entries.howto: The two numbers at the top are your shot. Keys 7 and 9 change the first, keys 5 and 8 the second, and key E fires it. A two player artillery game.

entries.title: The Binding of COSMAC
entries.desc: Simplified Isaac demake for SCHIP. 42 screens across three floors with an exciting boss battle at the end!
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move you around the room, key E fires. Forty two screens across three floors, with a boss at the end.

entries.title: Tick
entries.desc: Rhythm one button game for Chip-8
entries.howto: Tap key A in time with the beat. A rhythm game with one button, so timing is all of it.

entries.title: TOMB STON TIPP
entries.desc: Take turns pressing buttons to see who wins.

entries.title: Truck Simul8or
entries.desc: You're a kid, you're a truck.
entries.howto: Keys 5 and 8 pick a line on the menu and key 6 confirms it. You are a kid, you are a truck.

entries.title: Turnover '77
entries.desc: Roundabout de-make
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move you round the roundabout. Tap them rather than holding them, because it waits for you to let go.

entries.title: Ultimate Tic-tac-toe
entries.desc: Two player game
entries.howto: Keys 5 7 8 9 move your mark around the nine boards, key 6 places it. Two players share one keypad.

entries.title: WDL
entries.desc: That word game, but shorter.

entries.title: Wonky Pong
entries.desc: Pong, but wonky. Made for Octojam IV.
entries.howto: Keys 7 and A move the left paddle, keys E and F the right. Two player pong, so bring a friend.
